title: On the solvability of the discrete nonlinear Schrodinger equation with subcubic potential
summary: In this paper, we analyze the solvability of the discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation \begin{equation*} iβ(Δ_t+\nabla_t)φ(t,k) +γ|φ(t,k)|^2φ(t,k) +\varepsilon Δ_k^2φ(t,k-1) = g(t,φ(t,k)), \end{equation*} where $Δ_t$ and $Δ_k$ denote the standard forward difference operators in the variables $t$ and $k$, respectively, $\nabla_t$ denotes the standard backward difference operator in $t$, and \begin{equation*} Δ_k^2φ(t,k-1) = φ(t,k+1)-2φ(t,k)+φ(t,k-1) \end{equation*} is the discrete Laplacian operator in the spatial variable $k$.
